hints.The Matrix: Lean far back to dodge bullets in slow motion, put on dark glasses, and reach out to take one of two pills.
hints.Inception: Spin a top and watch it, bend space by folding the world over you, then fall asleep inside a dream inside a dream.
hints.Forrest Gump: Sit on a bench with a box of chocolates, run and run in a long straight line, and shrug with a simple, gentle smile.
hints.Pirates of the Caribbean: Sway across a ship deck with a wide swagger, swing a sword, wear a big hat, and search for treasure with an eye patch.
hints.Back to the Future: Check your watch, sit in a fast car, speed up until sparks fly, then spin an imaginary clock backward.
hints.The Godfather: Stroke a cat in your lap, hunch your shoulders with a low, brooding look, and offer something nobody can refuse.
hints.Gladiator: Fight with a sword and shield in an arena as a crowd roars, then turn to the emperor with a thumb pointing down or up.
hints.Mission Impossible: Hang from a rope above a floor, descend very slowly without touching it, hold your breath, and show a fuse burning.
hints.Jurassic Park: Stomp like a huge dinosaur with tiny arms and snapping jaws, and a cup of water ripples as it steps.
hints.Star Wars: Hold a glowing sword and swing it, breathe heavily like a dark mask, and reach a hand out toward someone.
hints.Home Alone: Put both hands on your cheeks with your mouth wide open in shock, then set clever traps for clumsy burglars.
hints.Ghostbusters: Carry a heavy pack on your back, shoot a beam at a ghost, and trap it in a box.
hints.Titanic: Stand at the front of a ship with your arms stretched wide, then slide down a sinking deck and float on a door.
hints.Batman: Spread a cape like wings, crouch on a rooftop, and shoot a grappling hook.
hints.Spider-Man: Shoot webs from your wrist, climb a wall, and hang upside down.
hints.Jaws: Paddle in the water with a nervous face, spot a fin gliding past, then snap your arms together like a mouth full of huge teeth.
hints.King Kong: Beat your chest like a giant ape, climb a tall building, and swat at tiny planes.
hints.The Wizard of Oz: Skip along a road with your arms linked with friends, click your heels three times, and shrink away from a green witch.
hints.Mary Poppins: Float down holding an umbrella, snap your fingers to tidy a room, and tip your hat.
Point a glowing finger, pedal a bike up into the sky, and slowly reach out to touch fingertips.
hints.Rocky: Throw fast punches at a hanging slab of meat, run up a long flight of steps, and raise both fists in victory.
hints.Indiana Jones: Crack a whip, tip a fedora, run from a giant rolling boulder, and swing across a pit.
hints.Avatar: Be a tall blue creature with a long tail, link your braid to a flying beast, and soar.
hints.Cast Away: Hold a ball with a face drawn on it, rub sticks to make a fire, and stare out at the sea from a beach.
hints.Top Gun: Put on sunglasses, spread your arms like jet wings and bank, then slap a high five.
hints.Mrs. Doubtfire: Pull on a wig and an apron, switch quickly between a goofy dad and a stern nanny, and hurry to hide.
hints.Psycho: Step into a shower, notice a shadow behind the curtain, and freeze in horror with a hand over your mouth.
hints.The Shining: Chop through a door with an axe, push your face through the gap with a crazed grin, and pedal a tiny tricycle.
hints.Casablanca: Tip a hat, light a cigarette, watch a plane take off, and wave goodbye with a sad look.
hints.Dirty Dancing: Run toward your partner, leap so they lift you overhead with your arms stretched out, then dance close.
